title: TemplateRenderRequest
description: AI-facing request schema for the default Remotion template flow. The caller should provide only coarse image categorization, assets, timing, and optional text.

version.description: Schema version for template rendering. Must be exactly '1.0'.

imageCategory.description: Coarse image category chosen by the upstream AI. This is the main signal used to select a Remotion template.

effectStyle.description: Optional style hint that can bias the template selector. This is a high-level choice, not a camera-keyframe input.

durationSeconds.description: Requested output duration in seconds. Must stay between 3 and 120 seconds.

fps.description: Optional output frame rate. Defaults to 60. Use 30 only when explicitly preferred.

preferredTemplate.description: Optional direct template override. Only provide this when the upstream AI is confident about the exact template.

assets.description: Image assets consumed by the template renderer. At least one asset is required. Multi-image or collage requests should usually provide at least two assets.

path.description: Path to the image file. This may be a project-relative path, absolute path, or already-public path.

width.description: Optional source image width in pixels.

height.description: Optional source image height in pixels.

label.description: Optional human-readable label for debugging or text overlays.

text.description: Optional plain text content. The skill does not invent text on its own.

captions.description: Optional caption list for templates that support additional callouts.

options.description: Optional rendering hints for the template renderer.

loopable.description: When true, prefer motions that can loop more naturally.

fit.description: Optional image fit hint. Use contain when the full image should be preserved, or cover when a fuller frame is preferred.

safeMode.description: When true, prefer conservative motions and safer template behaviors.
